== Biography ==
'''Eliza Glasgow''' was born about 1833 in County Antrim, Ireland. Her birth year is estimated from her stated age at marriage.

Eliza, aged twenty-one, a spinster of Liminary, married William Montgomery on 21 August 1854 at the registrar's office in Ballymena. William was a twenty-one-year-old weaver of Liminary and a son of James Montgomery, labourer. The register names Eliza's father as [[Glasgow-3956|Hugh Glasgow]], a labourer and weaver.<ref name="Marriage1854">General Register Office of Ireland, civil marriage register, marriage of William Montgomery and Eliza Glasgow, 21 August 1854, Ballymena registration district, entry 70; [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1854/09463/5428881.pdf digital image].</ref>

The original register directly establishes Eliza as Hugh's daughter. Her mother has not been identified.
